svg.title: Website category editing
svg.desc: Authorized administrators browse a tab, edit a category, and save or cancel. Saving prevents duplicate submission. A confirmed save refreshes rows and counts; failure retains the selection for an explicit further action.

html:div.style: color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(23, 33, 43) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
